comparison.objective: Trip and hold a breaker control switch until a green lamp lights; candidate fractures and recovers four HELICOIL tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Spring-return switch turning/holding versus coaxial mandrel placement, stabilized hammer impact, and fragment recovery.
comparison.success_condition: Named breaker tripped and lamp lit; no specs or numeric switch rubric provided. Candidate additionally requires four notch fractures, four contained tangs, undamaged retained inserts/shell, released tools, and stability.
comparison.reason: Tests sustained rotary control actuation and state indication, not controlled impact fracture and loose-fragment recovery.
